title: Finite-level descended objects and cohomology
statement: theorem finitePerfectAdic_actual_level_objects (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶ completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n) (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ) (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale) (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d) (hperfect : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n)) (hmark : FinitePerfectAdicLevelMarkings X d φ M V T) : ∃ K : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))))), (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))))) i).obj (K n))) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))))) i).obj (K n)))

proof.text: Apply the proved retained marked-origin construction independently at every level, choose its K_n, and retain its bounded cohomological interval and finite locally constant homology. The additional comparison and stalk conclusions can be forgotten.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AL, 09B1 and 09C6; forget fields of the proved retained marked origin (K3 2026-10-28).
